title: Add individual hole score editing with automatic recalculation

requirements.text: Modify the GolferScoreEntryList component to allow editing of individual hole scores after initial entry, maintaining the current score card interface structure

quotes: Allow for editing individual hole scores for each player

acceptanceCriteria: All hole score input fields remain editable throughout the score entry process
Users can modify any previously entered hole score at any time before final submission
Modified scores update the front nine, back nine, and gross total calculations immediately

requirements.text: Implement automatic recalculation of front nine, back nine, and gross totals whenever any individual hole score is changed

quotes: recalculating without having to start over

acceptanceCriteria: Score subtotals (front nine, back nine, gross total) update in real-time as hole scores are edited
Recalculation occurs without requiring page refresh or navigation
All validation rules continue to apply to edited scores (numeric, 1-15 range)

requirements.text: Ensure the LeaderboardView recalculates Callaway results automatically when returning from score entry with modified scores

quotes: recalculating without having to start over and reenter all scores

acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard standings reflect updated scores immediately upon navigation from score entry
Net scores, deductions, and adjustments are recalculated based on edited hole scores
Rankings update correctly with tie-breaking logic applied to modified results

constraints: Do not modify the backend Callaway calculation logic in main.mo
Maintain the existing validation rules (scores between 1-15, numeric input only)
Preserve the current score card layout and visual design
Keep the existing three-step workflow (event setup, score entry, leaderboard)
nonGoals: Adding undo/redo functionality for score edits
Adding confirmation dialogs before allowing score modifications
Creating a separate edit mode or edit button
